title: cornus sericea var. baileyi
intro: Cornus sericea var. baileyi, commonly known as Red Osier Dogwood, is a deciduous shrub native to North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Red Osier Dogwood include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with infections and autoimmune diseases. The bioactive constituents of Red Osier Dogwood include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable natural remedy.
